text:
Anya: Quick sync — product asks: our Q2 launch needs a hard decision today. We can't hit the window with current scope.
Matt: Agreed. Perf/infra flagged KV cache and embeddings as the biggest ops risk.
Sarah: Customer asks (Acme + two pilots) need tenant routing and SSO — high priority for sales.
Lee: From design, we can ship a simplified SSO flow for MVP (redirect-only) and save full SAML for v1.
Anya: Proposal: MVP = core chat + simplified SSO + baseline cost controls. Move embeddings cache persistence and async reranker to v1.
Matt: Technically that drops ~30% of infra lift. We also need to decide autoscale policy: keep conservative, or enable burst?
Sarah: Sales prefers predictability — reserved capacity would be ideal but not ready. Can we promise fallback model routing instead of capacity commits?
Matt: Yes — implement model-fallback to smaller quantized variant. That reduces rollout risk without infra commits.
Jen: Request from legal: audit logs in Private deployments are mandatory for enterprise pilot. Can we flag that as non-negotiable for those tenants?
Anya: OK — add audit logs for Private as a must-have. For hosted MVP we surface a roadmap note.
Lee: UX note — callout in signup flow for "pilot features may vary" to set expectations.
Matt: Timeline impact: if we cut embeddings persistence, we save 2 sprints. Fallback routing + simplified SSO fits the remaining sprint.
Anya: Decision checklist: 1) Cut embeddings persistence -> MVP? YES. 2) Move reranker to v1? YES. 3) Simplified SSO -> MVP? YES. 4) Autoscale conservative + fallback routing -> MVP? YES. 5) Audit logs for Private -> MUST.
Sarah: I'll align with Acme and tell them simplified SSO and audit logs for their Private pilot.
Jen: Noted. I'll update the compliance tracker and flag the audit implementation as release blocker for Private.
release-bot: Deploy window for MVP branch opens in 7 days. Runbook: `./scripts/release-check --mvp`
Anya: Great — I'll update the milestone doc and ping stakeholders. Can we reconvene tomorrow if any blocker pops up?
Matt: Yep. I'll post a brief infra risk note in eng-channel after this.
Lee: I'll ship the stripped SSO flows by EOD.
Sarah: Thanks team. I'll draft the customer comms for pilot expectations. :thumbsup:
Anya: Closing the thread — moving to milestone-reset board and tagging the release epic.
